summary: The R13-A1 LADDER PRE-SCORE REGISTRATION was registered before any score. It is in commit 3d48d35 (01:31:30Z), pushed at 01:31:34Z per the origin/main reflog. The poll.log copy inside that commit (last header 01:29:31Z) shows all four ladder refs PENDING, and they were still PENDING at 01:49:34Z. ladder_watch.py (committed f24ff72, 01:54Z) is read-only by construction: an allowlist of two CLI commands. It keeps a +-60 s guard around lb_poll, backs off 60 s twice on a 429 and then pauses 10 min, and parses the real 01:39Z poll.log block correctly. 35 tests pass. The dry run behaves as registered. kaggle 2.2.4 creates the -p folder itself. Four operational gaps put the A-only extension at risk; that extension is DROPPED if the watcher does not run. (a) The watcher dies on any unexpected exception. I confirmed that os.replace in save_state raises PermissionError [WinError 5] when a Python reader holds state.json open. (b) The 04:10Z start is late: scaled dummy runtimes put exp70d's score as early as ~04:05-04:30Z. Starting ~03:30-03:45Z with --s0 experiments/e10_watch/20260927T0147Z.txt closes this (offline import checked: count 40, rank 242). (c) HARD_CAP 09:40Z is tight for exp70b (~08:30-09:30Z). (d) exp70a's 8.0 h ledger condition relies on 10-min polls near its 05:17:47Z mark. There are also two text inconsistencies: the SELECTED read at ~05:00Z falls inside the quiet window, and a '03:04Z timer snapshot' is named that does not exist. E10 P1 01:47Z is NOT met. amanatar/optimized-biohub-max-score restarted at 01:39Z (ERROR->RUNNING) and should be watched by Chrome page view, not the API. No new submission mechanism is proposed.

findings.what: ladder_watch.py is not fail-soft. Watcher.run() catches only KeyboardInterrupt, so any other exception kills the process. By R13-A1 (3), a dead watcher means the A-only extension is DROPPED and attribution is lost. One concrete crash path: save_state() uses os.replace(tmp, state.json), which raises PermissionError on Windows while any Python process holds state.json open. The round-14 focus tells research agents to read experiments/lb_poll/ladder_watch/. Printing to an invalid stdout (detached start) is a second crash path.
findings.evidence: experiments/lb_poll/ladder_watch.py l.414-417 (save_state), l.897-902 (only KeyboardInterrupt caught). Reproduced in the scratchpad: open(state.json) + os.replace(state.tmp, state.json) -> 'PermissionError [WinError 5]'.
findings.action: Before the start, one of: (A) no code change: launch under a restart loop with stdout redirected: until python experiments/lb_poll/ladder_watch.py --s0 experiments/e10_watch/20260927T0147Z.txt --hard-cap 2026-09-27T11:30Z >> experiments/lb_poll/ladder_watch.stdout.log 2>&1; do sleep 60; done (state.json resumes; --s0 is ignored once S0 is set). (B) or a 3-line fix: in save_state, retry os.replace 5x with 1 s sleeps inside try/except OSError (log, do not raise); in main(), catch Exception -> log the traceback to watch.log, save_state, return 1 (so the loop in (A) restarts it). Also tell round-15 agents to read watch.log and calls.jsonl only, never state.json from Python.

Suppose ListSubmissions already shows two refs COMPLETE but the LB row has count 41 and a LastSubmissionDate equal to one ref's submit date. findings.what: Watcher code review: all checks pass, with minor nits only. Read-only: assert_read_only allowlists exactly 'competitions submissions <comp> -v' and 'competitions leaderboard <comp> -d -p <folder>/'; there is no submit or push path, and poll.log is only read. Spacing: calls are blocked within +-60 s of lb_poll's last or expected poll (header ts = poll start; median period ~603 s). 429: two 60 s back-offs, then a 10-min pause. Parser: correct on the real 01:39:32Z block (29 rows; tracked = the 4 ladder refs; freshness(40) fresh; expected_last 00:02:18). RE_429 has no false hit on real data. kaggle 2.2.4 makedirs the -p folder. The LB CSV is generated on demand (member timestamps == request times). The UP test is sound because public bests never decrease and Rank is unique. Nits (no action needed tonight): (i) the watcher downloads the LB even for events whose display is <= 0.953 (verdict NEG needs no LB), 1-4 extra calls; (ii) the poller guard ignores lb_poll's retry attempts at ~+30/+60 s after a failed first try (only matters while 429s are already happening); (iii) meta 'teams' shows 703 for the truncated --s0 import (cosmetic).
